title: "ggplot2 Practice"
format: html

Assignment for Monday, September 21, 2026.

Used the birth data file `nat2024samp5702.csv`.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
df <- read_csv("nat2024samp5702.csv")
```

## Birth weight histogram

`dbwt` is birth weight.

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = dbwt)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "cornflowerblue",
                 color = "blue",
                 boundary = 0,
                 binwidth = 250) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Changes to the dbwt graph

Changed the colors and binwidth & added axis labels.

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = dbwt)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "orange",
                 color = "black",
                 boundary = 0,
                 binwidth = 200) +
  labs(x = "Birth Weight (grams)",
       y = "Count",
       title = "Birth Weight") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Mother age

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = mager)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "lightblue", color = "black") +
  labs(x = "Mother Age", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Birth weight by sex

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = sex, y = dbwt)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Sex", y = "Birth Weight") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Gestational age vs birth weight

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = combgest, y = dbwt)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(x = "Gestational Age (Weeks)",
       y = "Birth Weight (Grams)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
